utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details too—once I’ve got them, I’ll let you know exactly what help we need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara. Just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details first—what exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, too—I heard it’s picking up, but I’m not sure what’s missing yet. What do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Meet me at the garage at 6; I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll meet you at the garage at 6.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what needs fixing first, and when are we heading over?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still catching up on the details, but I’d start with whatever’s most urgent first. If you can tell me what needs fixing, I’ll help line up when we head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think it’s still going okay, but I may have missed the latest changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve heard it’s been getting solid support, which is encouraging. I’m happy to keep an eye out for anything they still still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just tell me the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa’s got it organized — we’re set to start gathering the tools and sorting the requests. If you need the exact time and place, send me a note and I’ll get it added to the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — could you start with the broken chairs and any loose shelves? That would help a lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll start on the broken chairs and check the loose shelves too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear — sounds like folks are really stepping up. I’ll keep an eye out for anything they still need while I’m out and about.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, but can you confirm what we’re still short on? I’d rather know the exact list than guess.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Oren—thanks! I’ll spread the word and get the details to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great—thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and do my best to help when they come in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on our supply list for the repair drive—just tell me what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’m mostly worried about timing, boxes, and where we’ll store everything. Do we have enough boxes and a drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check on boxes and a drop-off spot today, then I’ll let you know. We should be able to sort the timing once I confirm that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo—just let me know when you’ve got the drop-off spot sorted, and I’ll bring my tools over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Awesome, thank you! I could use help spreading the word and collecting a few donated tools if you know anyone who has extras.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that — I’ll hand out flyers and ask around for extra tools too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
